blurb: A five-course, locally sourced dinner paired with Silver Thread wines, including sparkling and library selections. Reservations required.

name: Red Cat's Harvest Party
blurb: Great wine, three live acts, food trucks, vendors, lawn games and raffles benefiting the local fire department. Free admission, case discounts all day.

blurb: Seven wine brands, one afternoon. Taste with every maker who crafts wine at Ria's or works with grapes from their farm. $20 a person.

blurb: Music from Empty TV and a silent disco afterparty. Costumes encouraged.
